title: WorkerRegisterRequest
description: POST /v1/workers/register request body. See worker-protocol spec: 'Worker registration and session bootstrap', 'Versioned protocol identity'.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrently-acked runs the worker accepts.

version.description: Worker build version (e.g., contrabass git sha or semver).

supported_protocol_versions.description: Semver list of protocol versions this worker can speak. Cloud picks one (1.0.0 in v1).

kind.description: Optional self-declared worker type. Cloud uses for selection policy. Phase 2 sets 'container'.
